questions.prompt: Does unsolicited help establish a debt?
questions.answer: No; an obligation requires a legitimate agreement or duty.

questions.prompt: What evidence matters in a repeated commitment problem?
questions.answer: The actual agreement, conduct and impact.

questions.prompt: What if someone can no longer provide help?
questions.answer: Discuss feasible limits and alternatives where wanted.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Distinguishes mutual support, explicit obligations and coercive repayment demands; proposes sustainable arrangements.
scoring.transfer: Prepare a fictional reciprocity analysis comparing three forms of contribution, an explicit agreement and one voluntary offer. Identify a sustainable change, a consent check and an example of an invented debt to reject.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
